name: Alujain Corporation
summary: Alujain Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, produces and sells propylene and polypropylene products in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and internationally. It also engages in the manufacture, distribution, and sale of geo-synthetic products, as well as involved in the derivatives, establishment, and operation; and manufacture of plastics and synthetic rubber in their primary forms. In addition, the company operates and invests in petrochemical and chemical industries, as well as in basic and transformational, plastic, renewable energy, and other industries.
